notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Update content:

1. Now the paper information in the game has been changed to Chinese.

2. Due to setting the image quality too high in the game, the game cannot enter or is unresponsive Guys,

You can find it at this location [C:\Users\Administrator\AppData\Local\KunKunNight],

Delete the 'Saved folder' inside directly, and then reopen the game as the default setting.

3. If the game cannot run at the beginning and an error message 'DXGI-ERROR-DEVICE-REMOVED' pops up,

You can search for a solution on Baidu [How to fix DXGI-ERROR-DEVICE-REMOVED],

The solution is roughly

【1. Update graphics card driver】

【 2. Rollback graphics card driver 】

【3. Update DirectX】

【4.Turn off anti aliasing function in Nvidia control panel settings】

notes.title: Update content
notes.content:
Update content:

1. Adding a white candle to the drawer of the Beginning Room. After blowing it out, all the school lights will be turned off and a terrifying background sound effect will be generated. Players who want to experience higher difficulty can choose for themselves.

2. Added 1 colored egg.

3. Added 1 new Ending (currently 3 Endings in total).

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Now at the beginning of the game, a new black candle has been added to the top drawer of the room. When the black candle is blown out,

KunKun's whistle will disappear. Players can decide whether to blow out the candles at their own discretion.

Attention: Once the black candle is blown out, it will immediately disappear! Please choose carefully!

notes.title: 2023/11/7 Updated
notes.content:
Updated on November 7, 2023:

1.Now KunKun will whistle, which will let players know if KunKun is nearby.

2.The second floor library has added lighting, which makes it easier for players to peek at KunKun. The location of the cabinets on the second floor has also been changed, making it not easy for players to be seen by KunKun when coming out.

3.Now simplified Chinese has been added to the game, which is more suitable for Chinese babies' physique.

Thank you all for your understanding and support! Wishing everyone a pleasant game!

notes.title: 2023/11/5 Update
notes.content:
This update includes:

1. The lighting brightness on the first floor has slightly improved.

2.The movable items in Class 1 have now added bright special effects , and the Class 2 key's location have been changed.

notes.title: 2023/11/4 UPDATE
notes.content:
This update includes:

1. A hidden cabinet has been added outside the second floor library.

2.The 5 red books in the second floor library have now been added with a glowing effect. This can make it easier for players to find.
